subject: Ticket 18-remainder: mid-pattern over-match and any-colon split
description: Partially fixed in 05f786d (token-boundary matcher + seeded rules rewritten exact). Still open: (a) mid-pattern ':*' treated as a wildcard, so 'git:* push' matches 'git checkout push' - MORE permissive than native, and toolguard cannot express the literal 'git:* push' that native accepts; (b) any colon triggers the cmd:args split, so 'curl http://ex.com/*' fails to match. Heavy blast radius: measured 20 indirect test failures in the consolidation/redundancy/golden-corpus tier, none in test_permissions or test_patterns. Two runs disagreed on which files - RE-MEASURE. Replay the verdict corpus before and after. Tickets 20 and 22 are downstream and should probably be scheduled with it.
